Bug_Title: Nm: Class defines equal(Object); should it be equals(Object)? (NM_BAD_EQUAL)
Bug_Details:
This class defines a method equal(Object).  This method does
not override the equals(Object) method in java.lang.Object,
which is probably what was intended. equal(Object) equals(Object) java.lang.Object
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded in the generated code by defining a method named 'equal(Object)' instead of 'equals(Object)'. This method does not override the 'equals(Object)' method in java.lang.Object, which is probably what was intended.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test cases call the'showBug' method, which internally calls the incorrect 'equal(Object)' method instead of 'equals(Object)'. This triggers the bug because the 'equal(Object)' method does not override the 'equals(Object)' method in java.lang.Object.
